entities.name: Prostate cancer
observations: For localized unfavorable intermediate-risk disease, bone scintigraphy is recommended or considered for metastatic staging in the cited guideline summaries.
Routine bone scanning is generally not recommended for favorable intermediate-risk disease absent concerning clinical features.

entities.name: UIR bone scan threshold
observations: Unfavorable intermediate-risk localized prostate cancer is the lowest listed risk category at which conventional bone scan is recommended or considered for metastatic evaluation.

entities.name: FIR imaging not routine
observations: Favorable intermediate-risk prostate cancer generally does not warrant routine staging bone scan without concerning clinical features.
